revisions.reason: Review 20261121 disc-id session saves: attachDynamicOverlay picks its journal scope from mediaImport.overlayScopeFor (kept imports keep their library mediaId scope; session imports with a content fingerprint get a durable OPFS journal 'disc:v1:<sha256>'), logs a session-only fallback, and only kept journals set _keptMediaId. Store open/hydrate/flush/timer lifetimes, the OPFS-unavailable fallback and the stop flush are unchanged in shape; no guest entry, callback invocation, scheduler, renderer or context restoration changes. Covered by test/test-media-disc-id.js in run 20261121-disc-id-saves. General callback ownership remains pending.
